text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...A complete defeat. And I am certain 
there is not just one or two reasons for 
it."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Even if there had been some clever 
scheme, I don't think it would have 
altered the outcome."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We must review things from the ground up. 
A sturdy castle cannot be built upon a 
fragile foundation.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. After all, I do aspire to become 
an instructor.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to be flustered and 
helpless when my future students lose 
their way."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledge your lack of experience 
without acting timid, keep your eyes fixed 
ahead, and take that step forward.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I believe that is surely far more 
important... than any overly complicated 
theory.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"If I must be reborn to fight the battles 
that lie ahead, then that is simply what I 
shall do."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To achieve something great, one must be 
prepared to make sacrifices.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Now is the exact time we must demonstrate 
that.
